purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a Zyphos Mother Tree ancestral-recall vigil under memetic contamination pressure.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the root-terrace locality, ordinary ritual labor, four preparation choices, courier refusal, distributed recall, imperial intrusion, final priority, and three ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the terrace establishing frame, ordinary maintenance, petitioner threshold, each preparation action, eclipse fold, courier refusal, distributed recall, the one-sentence synchronized intrusion, final state, and each ending family.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt describes a complete frame in plain visible terms, including local geometry, lighting, materials, bodies, tools, and stance. Prompt assembly adds the single global style cue and only the stable refs for characters listed as visible in that frame.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Luminous ecological science-fiction storybook illustration, fine ink contours over restrained gouache, low-energy cold bioluminescence, wet bark and fungal translucency, readable nonhuman silhouettes, ritual intimacy, ecological wonder edged with biological unease, cinematic composition designed for interactive-fiction replay.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each generated prompt from global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for visible named characters or groups, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Visual continuity notes stay in review tooling. Each pass begins from the relevant camera-specific scene-set input when spatial continuity matters.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of an outdoor ritual chamber grown into the outer roots of an immense sentient tree on a rain-wet alien escarpment. Two house-thick buttress roots form a shallow bowl open to blue daylight and rain on the west side. A narrow living root connects the bowl to the massive trunk on the east side. At the center, a low oval basin holds a glossy translucent fungal membrane. Three feeding gourds hang above a pale root wrapped around a stone trough; six fibrous contact cords descend around the basin; a narrow salt rail crosses overhead; small cup-shaped fungal organs hang from thin root necks. An enormous neighboring planet covers the first edge of the dim sun. One six-limbed scaled climber works at the basin, another stands near the feeding root, and a small gliding courier with ribbonlike sensory vanes waits on the rail.

visible_characters.default_stance: anchored on the sloping root with upper claws and grasping feet, two smaller hands cleaning the basin
standing beside the feeding trough with precise lower hands on ritual tools
balanced on the overhead salt rail with sensory vanes partly open

visual_continuity_notes: The terrace is one open bowl between buttress roots: trunk/deep archive east, rainward opening west, witness basin center, feeding trough north, south feeder crack downhill, courier rail overhead, fungal cups east of the basin.
Umbros remains fixed above the rainward horizon and eclipse light progresses from dim blue to deep cold shadow.
